title: PromptTTSD: Controllable Text to Spoken Dialogue Synthesis with Open-Ended Text Descriptions
abstract: arXiv:2611.27601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spoken dialogue synthesis aims to generate multi-turn conversational speech from dialogue scripts while maintaining speaker consistency and contextual appropriateness. However, existing models largely lack fine-grained controllability, which is critical for capturing the dynamic, context-dependent style shifts in natural conversations. While prompt-based TTS has enabled such control for single-speaker speech, existing datasets heavily rely on predefined tags, which fundamentally limits their capacity to capture open-ended styles. To address this gap, we propose a scalable pipeline for extracting conversational speech from multi-narrator audiobooks, featuring an improved two-stage alignment algorithm to preserve dialogue continuity, paired with LLM-based extraction of style descriptions directly from narrative text. translated_title: PromptTTSD：基于开放式文本描述的可控文本到口语对话合成
translated_abstract: 口语对话合成旨在从对话脚本生成多轮对话语音，同时保持说话人一致性和语境的适当性。然而，现有模型在很大程度上缺乏细粒度的可控性，而这对捕捉自然对话中动态的、依赖上下文的风格变化至关重要。虽然基于提示词的TTS已为单说话人语音实现了这种控制，但现有数据集严重依赖预定义标签，这从根本上限制了其捕捉开放式风格的能力。为解决这一缺口，我们提出了一个从多叙述者有声书中提取对话语音的可扩展流程，采用改进的两阶段对齐算法以保持对话连续性，并结合基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法直接从叙事文本中提取风格描述。我们发布了PromptDialog——一个大规模多说话人对话语音数据集，包含8,383小时的中文语音数据。
tldr: 该论文提出PromptTTSD，通过从多叙述者有声书自动挖掘对话语音、改进两阶段对齐算法保持对话连续性，并利用LLM从叙事文本生成开放式风格描述，实现了以自然语言细粒度控制多说话人口语对话合成的能力，同时发布了8383小时中文的PromptDialog大规模对话数据集。
en_tdlr: PromptTTSD enables fine-grained, open-ended style control for multi-speaker spoken dialogue synthesis via LLM-extracted text descriptions from narrative content, supported by a scalable two-stage audiobook mining pipeline and the release of the 8,383-hour Chinese PromptDialog dataset.
